about_the_game:
Emerge from your underground vault into a hostile post-apocalyptic wasteland in this fast-paced roguelike shooter that blends intense surface combat with rich lore.

Fast-Paced Combat

Dash through bullet-hell encounters in tight 20-minute runs. Face hordes of varied enemies and challenging bosses, each requiring different tactical approaches. Choose from dozens of weapons that enable completely different playstyles - from close-quarters brawlers to long-range specialists.

Multiple Characters & Builds

Each playable character offers unique abilities and preferred weapon types. Experiment with tactical builds that synergize weapons, abilities, and items to create devastating combinations. Every run feels different as you adapt your strategy to the tools you find and enemies you encounter.

Story-Rich Vault Life

On the surface, every second is a fight for survival fast, brutal, and soaked in gore. But once the dust settles, you return home. Deep beneath the ruins lies your vault: a place of warmth, familiar voices, and peace. Talk with the AI, check in with other survivors, and slowly uncover what really happened to the world.

Meta Progression

Invest resources earned from runs into expanding and improving your vault. Unlock new facilities and upgrade existing systems,. Your vault grows stronger with each expedition, providing permanent benefits for future runs.

Key Features:

  • 20-minute roguelike runs perfect for quick sessions

  • Diverse enemy types and challenging boss encounters

  • Dozens of weapons enabling varied playstyles

  • Multiple playable characters with unique abilities

  • Story-driven conversations with AI and survivor NPCs

  • Deep meta progression through vault construction

  • Atmospheric pixel art combining wasteland grit with underground sanctuary aesthetics

Survive the surface. Build your sanctuary. Uncover the truth.

name: Vault Survivors

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or equivalent (any integrated GPU works)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any onboard sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12450H or AMD Ryzen 5 6600H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 3050 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any onboard sound card

short_description: Vault Survivors is a post-apocalyptic top-down roguelike shooter where you must survive 20 minutes against diverse enemies and bosses. Master dozens of weapons across different characters, then return to your vault to chat with your companions and upgrade your character between runs.
